mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 65 degrees under overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. The overnight low will be 57 degrees with no rain in the forecast, and the moon is currently a Waxing Gibbous.

The city is wrapping up the student I Voted sticker contest, where four winning designs will be chosen for the November election. Public voting starts July 28 and runs through August 7, so be ready to support our local K through 12 students.
We have plenty to do, starting with trivia at Hop Haus today. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and look forward to the Downtown Farmer's Market on July 29.
On July 13, police responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock, resulting in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.

Treat yourself to the Really Reese's flavor of the day. Since the store is currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when they open tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor will be Chocolate Volcano.
